tailoring_decisions.rationale: The appliance requires httpd for its HTTPS management endpoint.
tailoring_decisions.effective_control: Dedicated HTTPS-only service configuration, SELinux enforcement and firewall restrictions; validate the live endpoint.

tailoring_decisions.rationale: The appliance uses a rootful Podman IPv4 bridge with published ingestion ports; disabling host IPv4 forwarding conflicts with this network path.
tailoring_decisions.effective_control: Retain container bridge forwarding and firewall restrictions. Before release, verify permitted ingestion and management paths, denied transit and unpublished database ports, and persistence after reboot. Record this benchmark exception explicitly; live network isolation remains unverified.

tailoring_decisions.rationale: The appliance pins the vendor FIPS policy; changing it requires separate crypto qualification.
tailoring_decisions.effective_control: Retain vendor FIPS policy; assess any additional STIG algorithm restrictions as explicit findings.

tailoring_decisions.rationale: The appliance pins the vendor FIPS policy without an unqualified custom subpolicy.
tailoring_decisions.effective_control: Retain vendor FIPS policy and document additional STIG algorithm constraints in the assessment.

tailoring_decisions.rationale: The FIPS:STIG custom subpolicy is outside the currently qualified appliance crypto policy.
tailoring_decisions.effective_control: Retain vendor FIPS policy; track additional STIG SSH constraints separately while SSH is disabled.

tailoring_decisions.rationale: Opening SSH conflicts with the sealed appliance management boundary.
tailoring_decisions.effective_control: Retain closed SSH port and verify the active firewall and listening sockets.

tailoring_decisions.rationale: A sealed appliance disables remote SSH administration.
tailoring_decisions.effective_control: Local console setup and HTTPS management with mandatory administrator MFA; verify no SSH listener.

tailoring_decisions.effective_control: Retain vendor FIPS policy and independently check effective provider configuration; record unqualified STIG crypto constraints as findings.
